metadata.description: Documentation explaining data persistence, Supabase/Drizzle setup, shared types, and billing integration with Stripe
metadata.context: Explains how PostSpark handles data storage and payments

metadata.description: Project has schema and migrations in drizzle/, but runtime primarily accesses data with @supabase/supabase-js in server/db.ts. Teaches that tool existence doesn't mean primary runtime use
metadata.context: Important distinction between development tools and production code

metadata.description: Billing and balance cannot depend only on browser. Backend must control: who is user, which plan, how many Sparks, if operation can execute, how to respond to Stripe webhooks
Webhook is a call made by external service to notify that something happened. Example: Stripe calls /api/stripe/webhook to notify about payment events
metadata.context: How external services communicate with PostSpark
